Backport of #6228 to `r0.7.0`, cherry-picked from `2eca46823b0a2cb24f895bd567af14bef8350d37` without conflicts. The backport patch ID matches the merged source commit.

Adds GTP sharding, partial CUDA graphs, cuDNN layer normalization, and NCCL EP updates to the Nemotron 3 Ultra MXFP8 performance recipes for GB200, GB300, and VRNVL72. Includes the original training integration, CUDA graph validation changes, and updated unit tests.

The required VRNVL72 rename is already on `r0.7.0` through #6436.

Validation:
- All pre-commit hooks passed using `uv run --no-project --with pre-commit pre-commit run --all-files`.
- `git diff --cached --check` passed; patch ID matches the source commit.
- Attempted the five changed recipe and training unit-test files with isolated pytest; collection is blocked by missing PyTorch/Megatron-Core dependencies in the local environment. GPU runtime validation remains for CI.

The required VRNVL72 rename is already on `r0.7.0` through #6436.

+def _apply_nemotron_3_ultra_gtp(cfg: ConfigContainer) -> None:
+    """Apply rack-local dense GTP settings for Nemotron 3 Ultra on GB300.
+
+    Dense weights are sharded across one 64-GPU NVLink domain. Routed-expert
+    weights remain unsharded by GTP because EP64 already spans that domain;
+    this avoids expert-weight all-gathers across racks.
+    """
+    cfg.dist.use_megatron_fsdp = False
+    cfg.ddp.use_megatron_fsdp = False
+
+    # GTP is controlled through the user-facing total weight-shard counts.
+    # TP1 x GTP64 gives one dense-weight shard per GPU within a GB300 rack.
+    cfg.model.tensor_parallel_num_weight_shards = _GB300_NVLINK_DOMAIN_GPUS
+    cfg.model.expert_tensor_parallel_num_weight_shards = cfg.model.expert_tensor_parallel_size
+
+    # GTP currently supports only one distributed-optimizer instance.
+    cfg.ddp.num_distributed_optimizer_instances = 1
+    cfg.ddp.data_parallel_sharding_strategy = "no_shard"
+    cfg.ddp.outer_dp_sharding_strategy = "no_shard"
+
